title: Quantification of Foliar Polyphenolic Concentration Using a 96-Well Microtitre Method
author: Megan Nickerson
materials: To help with organization while adding reagents and samples to the plate, you can prepare your pipette tips to mimic the way reagents will be added. For example, have one pipette box with three columns only for the standard curve and blank samples; one full pipette box (12 columns) for F-C reagent; and a third full pipette box (12 columns) for Sodium Carbonate.

steps.title: Prepare Workspace and Equipment
steps.instruction: Clean and sterilize the tissue grinding cabinet and tools to prevent cross-contamination.

substeps.instruction: Clean the tissue grinding cabinet/work space with 10% bleach and 70% ethanol.
Spray with 95% ethanol and allow to evaporate.
Spray metal 1/8 tsp. scoops and racks with EtOH and allow to evaporate.

Prepare mortar and pestles: clean with detergent and water, rinse with DI water, submerge in 0.5% sodium hypochlorite for 30 minutes, rinse with DI water, wrap in aluminum foil, and autoclave for 30 minutes on dry cycle.

steps.title: Prepare Samples for Grinding
steps.instruction: Organize samples and prepare cooling agents.

substeps.instruction: Label 15 mL conical tubes to match sample IDs.
Fill a thermos with liquid nitrogen and add enough to a dewar to submerge 15 mL conicals.
Place 50 mL tubes containing lyophilized leaf tissue into the liquid nitrogen dewar.

steps.title: Grind Leaf Tissue
steps.instruction: Pulverize lyophilized tissue into a fine powder using liquid nitrogen.

substeps.instruction: Fill the mortar with liquid nitrogen from the thermos and submerge the pestle until the nitrogen evaporates.
Fill the mortar halfway with liquid nitrogen, add lyophilized leaf tissue, and push down with the pestle to submerge the tissue.
Gently stir with the pestle until liquid nitrogen nearly evaporates, then quickly grind to a fine powder.
Add more liquid nitrogen if necessary to prevent thawing until a fine powder is achieved.
Clean bench space with 10% bleach and 70% ethanol between each sample.

steps.title: Aliquot and Store Ground Tissue
steps.instruction: Transfer a measured amount of powder to labeled tubes and store.

substeps.instruction: Add one 1/8 tsp. scoop of ground tissue for each sample to the corresponding pre-labeled 15 mL conical tubes.
Return remaining leaf sample to original conical tube and store at -80°C.
Store the 15 mL conicals containing the subset tissue for MTP analysis at -80°C until use.

steps.title: Extract Polyphenols
steps.instruction: Extract polyphenols using acetone and ultrasonic treatment.

substeps.instruction: Set centrifuge to 4°C and prepare a bucket of ice.
Add 5 mL of 70% acetone to the 15 mL conical tube containing the 1/8 tsp. scoop of ground tissue using a 5 mL pipette.
Fill an ultrasonic water bath with DI water so a plastic rack floats without touching the bottom.
Loosen the conical tube cap and place it in the rack in the water bath.
Subject the tube to ultrasonic treatment for 20 minutes.
Dry the tube and centrifuge at 4°C and 3000 g for 10 minutes.
Label a 5 mL tube for each sample.
Use a new serological pipette for each sample to transfer the supernatant from the conical tube to the 5 mL tube.
Place extract tubes on ice.

steps.title: Prepare Tannic Acid Standards
steps.instruction: Create a stock solution and a serial dilution for the standard curve.

substeps.instruction: Label a 2 mL tube as 'Stock Tannic Acid' with the date.
Weigh 0.0015 g of solid tannic acid on an analytical balance and add to the tube.
Add 1.56 mL of nanopure water and vortex until dissolved.
Label two 8-strip tubes: D1-D6 (standards) and B1-B2 (blanks).
Add 15 µl of nanopure water to tubes D2-D6 and B1-B2.
Add 30 µl of stock Tannic Acid to well D1 and mix by pipetting.
Perform serial dilutions: transfer 15 µl from D1 to D2, mix, then 15 µl from D2 to D3, mix, and repeat for D4, D5, and D6.
Store tubes in a dark place.

steps.title: Prepare Reagents for Plate
steps.instruction: Calculate and prepare the Sodium Carbonate and F-C Reagent solutions.

substeps.instruction: Calculate the volume of 1M Sodium Carbonate needed: (number of samples + extras) x 80 µL.
Transfer this volume to a 50 mL reservoir in the chemical fume hood.
Prepare a 50 mL aliquot of autoclaved nanopure water.
Calculate total 1:10 F-C Reagent needed: (number of samples + extras) x 100 µL.
Calculate dilution components: F-C Reagent volume = total volume x 0.1; Water volume = total volume - F-C Reagent volume.
Transfer the calculated water volume to a new 50 mL reservoir using a 5 mL pipette.
Add the calculated F-C Reagent volume to the water reservoir, pipette mix, and use immediately.
Store any remaining diluted reagent in a bottle covered in tin foil and refrigerated (must be golden, not olive green).

steps.title: Perform Microtitre Plate (MTP) Assay
steps.instruction: Load the 96-well plate and incubate to quantify polyphenols.

substeps.instruction: Prepare and print a digital platemap with sample names, D1-D6, and B1-B2.
Using a 10 µl multichannel pipette, add 10 µl of tannic acid dilutions (D1-D6) and blanks (B1-B2), and 10 µl of acetone to the indicated wells.
Using a 2-20 µl pipette, add 10 µl of sample extract to the corresponding wells.
Using a 30-300 µl multichannel pipette, add 100 µl of F-C reagent to each well.
Using a 30-300 µl multichannel pipette, add 80 µl of sodium carbonate to each well and cover with a lid.
Incubate the plate at room temperature in the dark for 20 minutes.
Centrifuge the plate briefly with a tabletop centrifuge.
Package the plate in a Ziploc bag and secondary containment to prevent light exposure.
Remove the plate lid and allow it to evaporate.
Dispose of reservoirs in solid waste and fill out waste tags.

steps.title: Measure Absorbance
steps.instruction: Quantify the reaction using a plate reader.

substeps.instruction: Using a spectrophotometer fit for 96-well plates (e.g., BioTek Cytation5), measure absorbance at 630nm every 5 minutes for 60 minutes.

steps.title: Separate Non-Tannin Phenolics (Optional)
steps.instruction: Use PVPP to precipitate tannins and analyze simple phenolics.

substeps.instruction: Label 8-strip PCR tubes with three tubes per sample.
Transfer 10 µL of extract into each of the three tubes.
Add 90 µL of 70% acetone to each tube and mix by pipetting.
Add 1.0 mL of distilled water to a 2 mL tube.
Weigh 100 mg of PVPP in a 100x12mm test tube (Note: 100 mg binds 2 mg total phenols; dilute extract if phenolic content > 10% dry matter).
Add 1.0 mL of the total polyphenolic extract solution to the PVPP tube and vortex.
Keep the tube at 4°C for 15 minutes, then vortex again.
Centrifuge at 3000g for 10 minutes and collect the supernatant (containing simple phenolics).

Repeat the MicroMTP Method using at least double (preferably triple) the volume of supernatant. To avoid exceeding plate reader limits, double the amounts in a secondary container and transfer 190 µL of combined solution into the 96-well plate.
